errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the value 13.6%, which belongs to 'Hydro', to the category 'въздух' (air), which is a poor translation for 'Wind'. The correct value for 'Wind' is 12.7%.
The description incorrectly maps the value 5.3%, which belongs to 'Ambient heat', to the category 'геотермална енергия' (Geothermal energy). The correct value for 'Geothermal energy' is 3.1%.
The description incorrectly maps the value 12.7%, which belongs to 'Wind', to the category 'амбиентна топлина' (Ambient heat). The correct value for 'Ambient heat' is 5.3%.
The description incorrectly claims that the percentage for 'хидроенергия' (Hydro energy) is not specified, when the chart clearly shows its value is 13.6%.
